headline: TRAI wants FAST apps
to need a licence

events.text: I&B Ministry refers internet TV distribution to TRAI
Consultation paper out; 207 comments and 11 counter-comments
TRAI holds an open house discussion on the paper
Recommendations: 20-year app licence, ₹1 lakh a year per channel

note: Next: the I&B Ministry decides. Pricing still open.
